newsitem.title: UK: Europe cotton seeks lead from US futures.
newsitem.headline: Europe cotton seeks lead from US futures.

text.p: Lack of clear direction from New York futures meant there was little trading enterprise in European raw cotton markets.
Traders also cited divergence between the shipment periods for which sellers were willing to make offers and spinners' requirements.
Most demand centres on the third quarter, a period for which sellers seem unwilling to accumulate large sales unless buyers are prepared to pay carrying charges.

The two growths most frequently cited in new business continue to be Central Asian and West African. Portugal has noted some fresh business in Zimbabwe and East African styles for shipment from the middle of the year onwards.
